readme_summary: For macOS, you can reference this guide. For Linux, you can reference this guide. On macOS, make sure you have the **Xcode Command Line Tools** installed. This includes essential tools like `git`, `make`, and other development utilities: The Harmony project depends on the MCL (multi-curve library) and BLS (Boneh-Lynn-Shacham) cryptographic libraries. These need to be installed and configured before building the project. To ensure the libraries are correctly located when building the project, you need to add the MCL and BLS library paths to your `.zshrc` file. Add the following lines to your `.zshrc` (or `.bash_profile` for bash users): **Most repos from harmony-one assume the GOPATH convention. More information here.**
